items.b: GOLD'S LONDON FIX FALLS $116.50 TO $4,144.55, LOWEST SINCE 4 AUGUST
items.t: Silver's fix fell 5.67% to $61.33, platinum's 2.09% to $1,731.85 and palladium's 2.98% to $1,219.25. Spot gold read $4,144.10 at press time, $0.45 under Monday's fix and $30 higher on the session.

A $30.0m adjustment, cause not given. The miner expects a $73.5m net loss for the half to 30 June after a $125.2m Montepuez impairment, against $20.5m a year earlier, while headline earnings per share turned positive at USDc 0.6.

items.b: POLY AUCTION PUTS A HKD 25M HIGH ESTIMATE ON JADEITE
items.t: A 39-bead Burmese jadeite and diamond necklace, about $3.2m, leads a catalogue of more than 240 jewels in Hong Kong on 6 October. Sotheby's Paris follows on 8 October with a 16.01-carat Van Cleef ring at EUR 400,000.
